query:
MATCH p = ALL TRAIL (s:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}()
RETURN transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: Uses the evaluator-selected Database graph and the supplied player/follow schema. ALL TRAIL preserves all 1..3-hop outgoing paths while permitting repeated nodes and forbidding repeated edges. nodes(p) followed by transform maps ordered path nodes to business id values; no DISTINCT or list sorting, so parallel-edge paths retain duplicate id lists. References: documented-syntax.md MATCH grammar; patterns.md quantifiers and path type prefixes; documented-functions.md nodes() and transform(); functions.md lambda forms; checklist.md and relevant validation.md checks; identifiers.md and quote-identifiers helper confirmed generated identifiers need no quoting. Static review only; no database execution.
